verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents domain watchlists for expiry monitoring and a grace-deletion (redemption-like) window for lapsed domains, giving IT admins some safety net language, but there's no explicit documentation of per-domain auto-renew toggles or systematic expiry email notices. missing for 10: explicit auto-renew on/off control documentation, documented expiry notification schedule/emails, clear post-expiry redemption grace period timeline.
